channel.title: FlamingPiston
channel.description: Honest automotive reviews, practical buying advice, and maintenance guides.

item.title: Sierra EV vs BE 6: Both 5-Star, Which One to Buy?
item.description: Both have five-star Bharat NCAP ratings and start ₹66,000 apart. Tata Sierra EV vs Mahindra BE 6 on safety detail, prices, range, charging and space.

item.title: Innova Hycross Facelift Launched: Which One to Buy Now?
item.description: Innova Hycross facelift launched from ₹19.59 lakh; the flex-fuel hybrid starts at ₹19.99 lakh. Prices, what changed and which variant to buy.

item.title: Tata Sierra EV Gets 5-Star Bharat NCAP: One Weak Spot
item.description: Tata Sierra EV scores 30.62/32 for adults and 45/49 for children in Bharat NCAP, across all variants. The driver’s feet were rated marginal. Rivals compared.

item.title: Yangwang Altior Revealed: BYD’s 5.6-Metre Coach-Door Limo
item.description: BYD’s Yangwang Altior: a 5.6-metre, four-seat limousine with coach doors and a claimed 1,000 km CLTC range. First edition: 399 cars. No India plan yet.

item.title: Mahindra XEV 9S Gets 5-Star Bharat NCAP: Scores Explained
item.description: Mahindra XEV 9S scores 31.15/32 for adults and 45/49 for children in Bharat NCAP. How it compares with the XUV 7XO and Safari, and which variants it covers.

item.title: Honda November Offers: ₹1.86 Lakh Off City, None on Elevate
item.description: Honda City gets up to ₹1.86 lakh off in November, the Amaze up to ₹66,800, and the Elevate and ZR-V nothing. Valid until 30 November.

item.title: Mercedes GLC Electric at ₹78.50 Lakh: 6 Catches to Know
item.description: Mercedes GLC Electric buyer’s brief: ₹78.50 lakh, 94 kWh, 711 km claimed, just ₹1.5 lakh over the petrol GLC, and what India’s car leaves out.

item.title: 5-Star Bharat NCAP Cars Under ₹10 Lakh (November 2026)
item.description: Every car starting under ₹10 lakh with a 5-star Bharat NCAP rating, sorted by price, with adult and child scores and which variants each rating covers.

item.title: EV Battery Rental (BaaS) vs Buying: Break-Even Maths
item.description: BaaS cuts an EV's upfront price but charges per km. The break-even formula, worked examples for five EVs, and the terms to check before you sign.

item.title: Denza D9 Launched at ₹90 Lakh: Where It Fits vs Vellfire
item.description: BYD’s luxury brand Denza has launched the D9 electric MPV at ₹90 lakh and the Z9 GT at ₹1.568 crore. How the D9 compares with the MG M9 and Vellfire.

item.title: XUV 3XO CNG Gets 5 Stars: How It Compares With Brezza CNG
item.description: The XUV 3XO CNG scored 29.36/32 for adults and 45/49 for children at Bharat NCAP. How it stacks up against the Brezza CNG on price, boot and mileage.

item.title: Innova Hycross Facelift Teased: Book Now or Wait?
item.description: Toyota’s teaser confirms new headlamps for the Hycross facelift, launching 25 November. What is confirmed, what is only expected, and who should wait.

item.title: Brezza CNG vs XUV 3XO CNG: Boot, Spare Wheel or Power?
item.description: Both cost ₹9.99 lakh in their mid trims. The Brezza CNG keeps a 328 L boot and better mileage; the XUV 3XO CNG has a spare wheel and 200 Nm.

item.title: Isuzu V-Cross 2026: Pickup Practicality, 4WD and Which Variant
item.description: Isuzu D-Max V-Cross buyer’s brief, November 2026: ₹25.50–30.28 lakh, now 4x4-only, bigger screen and 360 camera on Z Prestige. Specification-led.

item.title: Kia Seltos 2026: Which Engine and Variant to Buy
item.description: Kia Seltos buyer’s brief, updated November 2026: ₹11.25 lakh start, turbo-petrol now DCT-only, five-star Bharat NCAP. Specification-led, not a road test.

item.title: Mahindra BE 6 SPORTEQ: BaaS or Outright Purchase?
item.description: Mahindra BE 6 SPORTEQ buyer’s brief, November 2026: ₹19.45–26.95 lakh or ₹11.45 lakh with BaaS, three batteries. Specification-led, not a road test.

item.title: Thar Roxx 4x4 2026: Capability or Costly Compromise?
item.description: Mahindra Thar Roxx 4x4 buyer’s brief, November 2026: diesel 4x4 from ₹19.42 lakh, five-star Bharat NCAP, which trim to buy. Specification-led.

item.title: Maruti Swift 2026: Mileage, AMT or CNG? Which to Buy
item.description: Maruti Swift buyer’s brief, updated November 2026: ₹5.84–8.89 lakh, six airbags standard, new CNG AMT. Specification-led, not a road test.

item.title: Skoda Kylaq 2026: Price, Automatic and Which Variant
item.description: Skoda Kylaq buyer’s brief, updated November 2026: ₹7.59–13.09 lakh, new Sportline trim, five-star Bharat NCAP. Specification-led, not a road test.

item.title: Volkswagen Virtus 2026: 1.0 TSI or 1.5 TSI?
item.description: VW Virtus buyer’s brief, updated November 2026: ₹10.71–19.20 lakh, five-star Global NCAP, facelift due in December. Specification-led, not a road test.
